identity.name: Fiksiraj
identity.description: A no-nonsense booking platform for Balkan home service professionals. It values clarity over decoration, speed over animation, and trust over trends.

typography.instructions: Import 'Manrope' from Google Fonts for headings. Use 'Inter' for everything else. Headings must be tight (tracking-tight). Body text should have relaxed line height.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Primary. Dark mode uses Slate-950 background with Slate-900 surfaces.
colors.gradients: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors. Subtle gradients allowed on primary buttons only (e.g., bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-blue-700).

layout.spacing_system: Use generous padding. Section padding: py-16 or py-24. Card padding: p-6 or p-8. Gap: gap-6 or gap-8.

grid_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid: mix of col-span-1, col-span-2, and row-span-2 items. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4' base.
grid_strategy.listings: Responsive Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-hover shadow-sm font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md

inputs.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-md h-11 px-4 text-base transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400

navigation.header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-50

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Grid Borders' style for dashboard sections: border-r border-b border-slate-100.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Add 'active:scale-95' to all interactive elements. Use 'group-hover' for card interactions.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width: 1.5px or 2px. Size: w-5 h-5 (default).
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use simple SVG illustrations or muted icons in a circle bg-slate-50.

media.image_style: Object-cover. Rounded-lg for independent images. Full-width for hero backgrounds. Add a subtle overlay (bg-slate-900/10) if text is over image.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-slate-500 is only used on white backgrounds. Use text-slate-600 for better readability.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Follow the 'Swiss Utility' persona. Keep it clean, structured, and fast. Avoid decorative elements that don't serve a purpose.

specific_pages.landing: Use the 'Hero' image with a bold H1: 'Profesionalci na dohvat ruke' (Professionals at your fingertips). Use the 'primary' blue for the main CTA 'Pronađi Majstora'.
specific_pages.dashboard: Use a sidebar layout. The main content area should be a 'Bento Grid' of stats (Today's Bookings, Revenue, Rating). Use 'Grid Borders' styling.
specific_pages.booking_flow: Step-by-step wizard. Clean inputs. Large clickable areas for time slots. Use 'Secondary' button style for unselected slots, 'Primary' for selected.

instructions_to_main_agent.components: Reuse Shadcn components from /src/components/ui. Customize them to match the 'Swiss Utility' style (remove rounded-xl, use rounded-lg or rounded-md).
instructions_to_main_agent.localization: Ensure all static text is in Croatian. Use 'date-fns/locale/hr' for date formatting.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do NOT use gradients for text or backgrounds unless specified.
Do NOT use centered text for long paragraphs. Left align is better for reading.
Ensure mobile responsiveness: 'max-w-full' for images, stack grids on mobile 'grid-cols-1'.
